# Single-mode (2026-07-02): the old "Thrive user"/"Survive user" attributions and reintro/symptom
#    stories are retired with the two-mode design.
Eating across more colors each week made hitting 30 plants feel like collecting, not a chore.
I never knew how few different plants I was eating until the weekly count showed me. Now I hit thirty most weeks.
The garden blooming when I kept feeding the same crews made the science click in a way a chart never did.
The quiet heads-up that one food kept showing up on my rough days helped me spot a pattern I had missed for years.
Snapping a photo instead of weighing and typing meant I actually kept logging past week one.
Watching my energy trend up as my plant count grew was the nudge that kept me going.
